newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yuganskneftegaz to issue tax arrears bonds.
newsitem.headline: Yuganskneftegaz to issue tax arrears bonds.

text.p: Yuganskneftegaz, one of Russia's biggest oil companies, is to issue 1.72 trillion roubles ($298.8 million) in bonds to the government under a state scheme forcing tax debtors to pay off their arrears, privatisation minister Alfred Kokh's spokeswoman said on Monday.

Another oil company, Samaraneftegaz, which like Yuganskneftegaz is part of the NK YUKOS vertically integrated oil group, will issue 384 billion roubles of bonds under the same programme, Viktoria Vergelskaya told Reuters.

Yuganskneftegaz is one of Russia's biggest corporate tax debtors, owing a total of 3.25 trillion roubles, including fines. Samaraneftegaz owes a total of 741 billion roubles. The bonds cover tax debt excluding fines.
The companies will issue the bonds, backed by company assets, to be held in trust by the government's Federal Property Fund (RFFI).
If the companies default on payments of the taxes and the fines, the government can sell the asset-backed bonds.
YUKOS is part of a financial-industrial group controlled by Bank Menatep.
